outlook.statement: The real estate sector is likely to continue on its journey of long term growth as we see a continuous rise in GDP per capita, larger disposable incomes, growing urbanization and most of all a larger focus of the world on us as the next big economy.

The Indian Real Estate Sector has entered a phase of sustained structural growth, underpinned by robust macro fundamentals, a supportive policy environment, and an aspirational, urbanising population. The sector is valued at approximately US$ 650 billion in 2025 and is projected to reach US$ 1 trillion by 2030 and expand to US$ 5.8 trillion by 2047, with its contribution to GDP expected to grow from 7% to 15.5% by 2047.
Company is expected to increase turnover and profitability by 10 to 15%.

The Company remains positive about the long-term direction of the sector on back of higher consumer confidence and increasing affordability due to declining interest rates, stagnant real estate prices and rising disposable income. Consolidation in the residential real estate sector is expected to continue, leading to an increase in the market share of branded organized players such as the Company. The Company is poised for a better growth trajectory compared to the current year.
Fast turnaround deals shall be a specific focus area for new deals in FY 2026-2027. The Company will focus on opportunistic growth avenues to create a healthy project pipeline across its markets.

India's residential real estate sector to remain stable with quality-led growth in 2026; premium and high-end housing to continue attracting developer focus; home prices in major urban centers expected to rise at a measured pace; RBI repo rate cut to 5.25% provides demand catalyst.

Indian office market heads into 2026 with one of the strongest outlooks in Asia-Pacific; rentals in Bengaluru, Mumbai, and NCR projected to grow 7.5-9% YoY; deal pipelines point towards 100 million sq. ft. annual leasing milestone within next two years.
Indian real estate sector valued at ~US$ 650 billion in 2025, projected to reach US$ 1 trillion by 2030 and US$ 5.8 trillion by 2047; GDP contribution expected to grow from 7% to 15.5% by 2047.
India's GDP growth for FY 2025-26 estimated at 7.4-7.8%, moderating to 6.4-7.2% for FY 2026-27; RBI projects 6.6% for FY 2026-27; IMF affirms India as world's fastest-growing major economy.

The global economic environment remains complex with trade tensions, geopolitical volatility, and energy supply disruptions; IMF projects global growth at 3.1% in 2026 and 3.2% in 2027. India stands out with FY2025-26 GDP growth of 7.6% and FY2026-27 forecast of 6.5%, driven by domestic demand, infrastructure capex, and supply chain realignment. Real estate sector contributes 7.3% to GDP and is a catalyst for 250+ allied industries. Company enters FY2026-27 with strong booking value, collections, operating cash flows, net profit, robust launch pipeline, good balance sheet, and deep market presence.
